rules.semantic: A walker never banks more than 50 extra act rounds: any surplus is discarded at the start of its act, not carried over.

arms.observable: one act() runs exactly 51 rounds (drawcycle advances by 51) and bonus_rounds ends 0

rules.semantic: A living walker with banked bonus rounds (granted by an enemy-team mage's FREEZE TIME to its allies) takes one full extra act per banked round, all in the same tick; every per-tick timer (invulnerability, invisibility, flight, charm, speed bonus, rests, lunge) therefore also runs down once per round. A dead walker takes none.

arms.observable: act() recurses once per round; drawcycle and every countdown advance N+1 times this tick; bonus_rounds ends 0

rules.semantic: A dead walker does nothing in its act; a walker that dies falling down a pit (apply_z_motion) stops acting that same tick.

arms.observable: act() returns 0, no timer or drawcycle change
act() returns 0 the tick it falls; no AI command queued

note: unasserted: pit death in apply_z_motion: no cited test asserts act() returns 0 the tick the walker falls, nor that no command is queued

rules.semantic: A walker forgets a foe that is dead or hidden (dug in / riding a body), and loses track of a cloaked foe with a chance that grows with the foe's remaining invisibility (a roll of next(invis/20) above 0); a negative cloak counter is treated as no cloak.

arms.when: foe invisible < 20 or roll 0 / negative counter

rules.semantic: A walker never keeps a friend as its foe: a foe that became friendly (charmed onto our side, or we were charmed onto its side) is dropped.
A follower whose leader has died forgets the leader (so a later Yell can recruit it again).
A summoned or owned living dies when its owner dies.

arms.observable: summon dead()==1, death() run, act returns 0

rules.semantic: A walker with a lifetime (a summon) dies if it has no owner, otherwise its lifetime counts down one per act and it dies when it reaches 0. A lifetime of 0 means permanent.

arms.observable: dies on the act its lifetime reaches 0 (lifetime 1 dies on the next act)

note: unasserted: lifetime > 1: no test asserts the one-per-act decrement (cited tests start at lifetime 1)
unasserted: lifetime 0: no test asserts a permanent (lifetime 0) walker never expires

rules.semantic: After a seated hero thaws it is immune to a new freeze for a short window; that negative phase climbs back toward 0 by one per act, even if the seat has switched away.

arms.observable: raw +1 per act until 0; frozen_delay() reads 0 throughout

rules.semantic: HP and MP regeneration stop for every walker while a FREEZE TIME bank (world.enemy_freeze) runs, and for a walker while it still has banked bonus rounds; HP regen also waits out regen_delay after damage.

arms.observable: hitpoints and magicpoints unchanged after act
no regen on the rounds that still have rounds banked
+per_round each act, +1 extra each max_delay acts, capped at max

rules.semantic: A view-all (see everything) bonus lasts its count of acts.
note: unasserted: 0: view_all stays 0 (only the 1 -> 0 decrement is asserted)

rules.semantic: Invulnerability lasts its count of acts.
note: unasserted: 0: invulnerable_left stays 0 (only the 1 -> 0 decrement is asserted)

rules.semantic: Invisibility lasts its count of acts and keeps its outline while it lasts; once it is out the outline is cleared.
Flight (potion or spell) lasts its count of acts.

A non-flying walker standing inside impassable terrain (a wall, water, trees without forestwalk) loses 1 HP per act (a red '1' damage number) and is given one tick of flight so it can step out; at 0 HP it dies.

arms.observable: hp -1, flight_left becomes 1 (then decremented next act), a DamageNumber(1, RED) pushed

note: unasserted: inside impassable, no flight, hp > 1: the 1-HP loss, flight_left 1 and the red DamageNumber(1) (only the lethal arm at 1 HP is asserted)

rules.semantic: Charm lasts its timer; when it runs out the walker goes back to its real team (real_team_num is cleared to 255). A walker that was never charmed keeps its team.
note: unasserted: never charmed: team unchanged and charm stays 0

rules.condition: BIT_FORESTWALK && any corner on TYPE_TREES (floor-0 smoother) or a concealing decor cell on own floor
rules.semantic: A forestwalker (elf, druid...) that has any corner of its box in trees or in concealing decor (a SHRUB) moves at a forest pace; out of the trees its step is reset to its normal stepsize every act.

arms.when: forestwalker, a corner in trees or shrub

missing_arms: forestwalker, a corner in trees or shrub

rules.semantic: Walking in the forest costs a forestwalker one MP each time its magic-regen delay is at 0.
In the forest a forestwalker's step shrinks by 4 - dexterity/10 (a player character) or 4 - level/2 (an NPC), never by a negative amount and never below 1 px.

rules.anchor: if (speed_bonus_left() > 0) // 2002 said `> 1`: N ticks gave N-1 and the field stuck at 1, so "not hastened" (== 0) was never true again
rules.semantic: A speed bonus of N ticks gives N ticks of extra step (stepsize + speed_bonus) and then ends at 0.
A special's rest between casts (FREEZE TIME, HOWL, SCARE, MIND CONTROL...) counts down one per act.
An attack lunge (sprite offset) eases back by 0.4 per act and stops at 0.
note: unasserted: 0: attack_lunge stays 0 (the decrement and the clamp are asserted)

rules.semantic: A hit recoil (sprite offset) eases back by 0.6 per act and stops at 0.
note: unasserted: > 0.6: the -0.6 decrement itself (living_act_timers_charm_and_recoil_clamps starts at 0.3 and asserts only the clamp to 0)

rules.semantic: A family (or mode) Lua on_act_override that returns true owns the walker's act for that tick: none of the animate/frozen/command/AI steps run.

arms.observable: falls through to the default act

rules.semantic: A walker in the middle of an animation (attack, cast, death...) finishes it before it does anything else: no frozen drain, busy drain, turn, command or AI that tick.

arms.observable: animate() result returned; busy, commands and frozen unchanged

rules.semantic: A frozen walker spends its act thawing by one and does nothing else.
The firing delay (busy) counts down by one per act.
A walker not yet facing where it wants to go spends its act turning one notch toward it.

arms.observable: turn() result returned, no command/AI run

rules.semantic: A walker with queued commands carries them out before its AI; a command step that does something ends the act.
The exit-pad skip counter counts down one per act.
An AI (unseated) walker with an action order (ACTION_FOLLOW from Summon Defense) runs that order first; if the order acted, the AI does not also run. A seated hero ignores its action.

arms.observable: act returns do_action's value; act-type AI skipped (rng untouched)

arms.when: seated or no action or order passed

missing_arms: seated or no action or order passed

rules.semantic: A seated hero (ACT_CONTROL) has no AI: its act ends after the timers and commands; the seat's input drives it.
A guard runs its guard logic (wake on sight, hold post); see walker act_guard rows.
A walker set to the die act type dies on its next act.
An ordinary bot considers its special one act in five; the other four it takes the ordinary act.
A bot considers a special only when it can pay for its slot 1; otherwise the special roll is spent on act_random (seek and fire).

rules.condition: slot > 4 && fixes==0 || slot < 1 || slot >= FD_NUM_SPECIALS || !fd || name == NONE
rules.semantic: A bot rolls a slot uniformly from the slots its level opens (bot_slot_roll_bound); classic folds any roll above slot 4 and any unnamed slot to slot 1; with Gameplay Fixes on, slots 5+ that are named and open stay (the bound never passes the last named slot).

arms.when: NONE / out of range / no descriptor

missing_arms: NONE / out of range / no descriptor

rules.semantic: A bot that rolled a slot casts it only if its gate (check_special) says yes; a gate refusal is traced 'special held'; a successful cast is the bot's act.

arms.observable: TRACE special 'held id=...', falls to living.cpp:385

rules.semantic: Classic: a special roll that the gate or the cast refused is still the bot's whole act (it stands still). Gameplay Fixes W: the refused roll is not the act; the bot takes the ordinary act the coin would have given it (seek, fire, search).

arms.observable: continues to the 1-in-5 act_random / 4-in-5 search arm; a command is queued

rules.anchor: if (!current_game->world->rng_.next(5) ) //1 in 5 to do act_random() function
rules.semantic: On its ordinary act a bot runs act_random (seek and fire) one time in five and the seek/search routine four times in five.

Seeking: a bot without a foe looks for a near one; with a foe it snaps its facing to the nearest even (orthogonal) direction and searches for it for 300 steps; with none near it either finds the nearest foe anywhere (half the time) or wanders 20 steps.
note: unasserted: no foe, coin 0: foe = find_nearest_foe with no command queued this act

rules.semantic: A walker with no known act type does nothing.

rules.condition: target alive && we are Living && is_friendly(target) / rng.next(3) && target not ACT_CONTROL
rules.semantic: A walker only shoves a living ally; two times in three the ally is shoved, never a seated hero (the rng(3) draw happens even for a seat).

arms.observable: returns 0, target queue untouched, one rng draw

rules.semantic: A shove never steals an ally's orders when the step it would inject is blocked by terrain (the 2026-07-10 livelock fix): the ally keeps its own search.

arms.observable: queue cleared, on_shoved hook, COMMAND_WALK x4 (x,y) forced, returns 1

rules.condition: curdir() == dir / else / act_type != ACT_CONTROL || has_commands()
rules.semantic: A walker steps only when already facing the step's direction; otherwise the walk just records the new facing and turns one notch (a seated hero walking by keys does not turn here, its act turns it, so it never turns twice in one tick).

arms.observable: enddir set, turn() one notch, no move, returns 1

arms.when: facing differs, seated hero without commands

missing_arms: facing differs, seated hero without commands

rules.semantic: A walk never leaves the map.

A step moves only if the destination is passable at its exact, rounded-up and rounded-down offsets (so a fractional step cannot clip a corner into trees or walls); the walk-cycle frame advances on a move.

arms.observable: worldmove, cycle +1, walk frame set, returns 1

rules.semantic: A refused step shoves a living ally in the way. Classic: the ally named by collide_ob, which can be stale (the last body any probe touched, however far, or one left behind across a teleporter). Gameplay Fixes X: only a body this very step met is shoved.

arms.observable: shove draws rng(3) and may steal the far ally's orders

arms.when: fixes on, step did not meet it
arms.observable: no shove, no draw, ally keeps its order

rules.semantic: A walker flagged always-animate (e.g. slime) cycles its walk frames even when its step is blocked.

rules.condition: order Living/Generator / order Weapon -> descriptor is_auto_attackable
rules.semantic: Walking into a living or a generator starts an attack; a weapon-order object (a door, a barrel) only if its family says it is auto-attackable; treasure and effects never.
A walker that bumps a live hostile (living, generator or auto-attackable weapon) swings at it; bumping an ally only records it as the collision body.
A placed NPC with specials disabled by the scenario never decides to use a special.

New Specials: a bot that tossed the Shift coin but cannot pay its slot's PRICED alternate (e.g. MINE) casts the plain slot instead; checked again after any fall-back to slot 1. Never with New Specials off.

arms.when: new specials on, priced alternate unaffordable
affordable or unpriced alternate or setting off

rules.semantic: A bot that cannot pay for the slot it rolled falls back to its slot 1.
The family's Lua bot gate (check_special_ai) can refuse the cast (no foe in reach, nothing to heal...); without a gate a bot always may.

arms.when: gate says yes or no gate

rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes AB: a gate's yes the bot cannot pay for (the slot-1 fall-back's own price, or the Shift arm the gate chose) is a no; classic said yes and the hit-response cast was then refused NOT ENOUGH MP.
A placed walker's level scales its stats: by its family's Lua coefficients when it has a set_difficulty hook, else by the default +11*L^2 HP and MP, +4*L damage, +2*L^2 armor.

rules.anchor: if (team_num() != 0)  // hostile/neutral teams: legacy path, untouched
rules.semantic: The difficulty percent scales max HP, max MP and damage of every placed walker, foes and placed team-0 NPCs alike (A12a); only a walker carrying a player character is exempt. At 100% team-0 NPCs skip the multiply (bit-exactness).

A placed walker's HP regeneration rate comes from its level: whole points per tick from 4*L^2/REGEN, and the remainder as one extra point every REGEN/(rem+1) ticks, never faster than every 2 ticks; regeneration starts with an empty delay.

arms.observable: heal_per_round += quotient (the loop runs while the delay exceeds REGEN)

note: unasserted: remainder > 1: max_heal_delay = REGEN/(rem+1) exact value

rules.semantic: A placed walker's MP regeneration rate comes from its level the same way, from 30*L^2.
note: unasserted: remainder > 1: max_magic_delay = REGEN/(rem+1) exact value

rules.semantic: act_random retargets to a near foe one time in 80 (or whenever it has none); with no foe near it wanders 40 steps.

arms.observable: foe = find_near_foe; a foe in range is latched, curdir/enddir turn toward it and a command is queued

still no foe after the search

foe unchanged, continues to the fire/search logic (living.cpp:746)

note: unasserted: roll 0 (next(80)==0) with a foe already held: foe re-acquired by find_near_foe

rules.semantic: act_random: a foe inside the line-of-sight box is fired at if a shot can reach it (COMMAND_FIRE for a random 0-23 count); a blocked shot turns toward the foe. Either way out of a shot, it searches 200 steps.
note: unasserted: out of range: COMMAND_SEARCH x200 with the foe outside the line-of-sight box (the cited test only drives in-range foes; its x200 search is the BIT_NO_RANGED blocked arm)

rules.semantic: An ally on Follow (Summon Defense) fights its own foe if it has one; otherwise it follows the nearest player hero and takes up that hero's foe; with no foe anywhere it queues a 5-step follow. Unknown actions do nothing.
